verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the shoe is pulled off its green circle and left floating on the left, and the empty circle sits bottom-right. 'Full review inside.' runs into the top of the circle, the NEW VIDEO badge is shrunk to an unreadable size and stuck to the circle's bottom edge, and there is a large dead area in the upper left. B keeps the shoe with its circle and has a readable top-down order, but the shoe is only partly on the circle so the pair looks misplaced. The NEW VIDEO badge and the logo are squeezed into the space above the headline, and the logo now competes with the headline. The headline wraps awkwardly ('100' sits at the end of line one), and the bottom-left corner is empty.
